name: ReflectionUtils
documentation:
Utility class for high-performance reflection-based operations across the Fluxzero Runtime.

This class is intended for internal use only. It provides a wide range of methods for accessing and manipulating object members via reflection, including:

  • Resolving annotated fields and methods (with support for meta-annotations)
  • Accessing nested property paths via getters and setters (e.g., {@code "user/address/street"})
  • Efficient member access using {@link DefaultMemberInvoker}, which leverages {@code LambdaMetafactory} for near-native invocation performance
  • Generic type resolution, including collection element types and supertype inference
  • Annotation hierarchy traversal and support for Kotlin nullability reflection (if available)
  • Utilities for determining override relationships, class hierarchies, and bean property metadata
  • Robust handling of {@link Class} loading and safe access to field/method/property values

Performance Considerations

This class uses extensive caching and memoization to avoid redundant reflective operations at runtime. All public methods are safe to use in high-performance contexts such as annotation scanning, handler dispatching, and JSON schema validation.

Modular Use

If Fluxzero adopts JPMS (Project Jigsaw) in the future, this utility would likely be placed in an internal module and not exported to consumers, to preserve encapsulation and forward compatibility. @see MemberInvoker @see DefaultMemberInvoker @see JsonUtils @see TypeRegistry

methods.name: asClass
methods.documentation: Returns the represented Java class for a class literal, or the runtime class of an ordinary object.

methods.name: asInstance
methods.documentation:
Instantiates a Java or supported Kotlin class literal using its no-argument constructor; returns ordinary
 instances unchanged. Construction failures are wrapped in {@link IllegalStateException}.

classExists
methods.documentation: Returns whether the SDK's class lookup can resolve the supplied class name.

methods.name: classForName
methods.documentation: Resolves a class name through the SDK's class lookup; throws {@link ClassNotFoundException} if unresolved.

methods.name: classForName
methods.documentation: Resolves a class name, returning {@code defaultClass} when it cannot be resolved.

methods.name: convertAnnotation
methods.documentation: Converts the annotation's attributes into the requested representation.

methods.name: copyFields
methods.documentation:
Copies all non-static fields between objects of the same runtime class and returns the target. Null inputs
 leave the target unchanged; arrays return the source instead of copying elements.

methods.name: declaresField
methods.documentation: Returns whether the target type itself declares the named field, excluding inherited fields.

methods.name: determineCommonAncestors
methods.documentation:
Returns common ancestor types for the runtime classes of the elements, treating null elements as {@link
 Void}.

methods.name: ensureAccessible
methods.documentation:
Enables reflective access to the member and returns it; platform access restrictions can still reject the
 operation.

methods.name: getAllInterfaces
getAllMethods
methods.documentation: Returns the cached methods discovered across the type hierarchy.

methods.name: getAnnotatedFields
methods.documentation: Returns discovered fields carrying the annotation directly or through a meta-annotation.

methods.name: getAnnotatedFields
methods.documentation: Returns matching annotated fields on the target or represented class, or an empty list for a null target.

methods.name: getAnnotatedMethods
methods.documentation:
Returns discovered methods carrying the annotation directly, through a meta-annotation, or through an
 overridden declaration.

methods.name: getAnnotatedMethods
methods.documentation: Returns matching annotated methods on the target's runtime class, or an empty list for a null target.

methods.name: getAnnotatedProperties
methods.documentation:
Returns annotated fields and readable methods, deduplicated by property name, including inherited and
 meta-annotated properties.

methods.name: getAnnotatedProperty
methods.documentation: Returns the first annotated property discovered for the type, or an empty optional when none matches.

methods.name: getAnnotatedProperty
methods.documentation:
Returns the first matching annotated property on the target or represented class, or an empty optional for a
 null target.

methods.name: getAnnotatedPropertyInvoker
methods.documentation: Returns a cached invoker for the first matching annotated property, with reflective access enabled.

methods.name: getAnnotatedPropertyName
methods.documentation: Returns the logical name of the first matching annotated property, if present.

methods.name: getAnnotatedPropertyValue
methods.documentation: Reads the first matching annotated property, returning an empty optional for a missing or null value.

methods.name: getAnnotatedPropertyValueOrNull
getAnnotatedPropertyValues
methods.documentation:
Reads all matching annotated properties and returns their non-null values; a null target yields an empty
 collection.

methods.name: getAnnotation
methods.documentation: Returns a direct or composed annotation, using inherited method and type lookup where applicable.

methods.name: getAnnotationAs
methods.documentation:
Finds a matching type annotation and projects its attributes into the requested representation; null or
 unmatched targets yield an empty optional.

methods.name: getAnnotationAs
methods.documentation:
Returns the annotation or its matching meta-annotation when {@code returnType} is the target annotation
 type. For maps and converted objects, merges meta-annotation defaults with the outer annotation's
 attributes, which take precedence. A null annotation or target annotation type yields an empty optional.

methods.name: getAnnotationAs
methods.documentation:
Finds a matching annotation on the element and projects its attributes into the requested representation, or
 returns an empty optional if absent.

methods.name: getAnnotationAttribute
getAnnotationAttributes
getAnnotations
getCallerClass
methods.documentation:
Returns the first calling class outside the immediate invoking class and {@code java.*}, or null if none is
 found.

methods.name: getCollectionElementType
methods.documentation: Resolves the collection element or map value class from a field or method's generic type.

methods.name: getCollectionElementType
methods.documentation:
Resolves the first generic argument, or the value argument for maps, using a wildcard's upper bound. Returns
 {@link Object} for unresolved arguments and an empty optional for raw types.

methods.name: getDefaultConstructor
methods.documentation: Returns the default constructor declared by the supplied type, if present.

methods.name: getEnclosingClass
methods.documentation: Returns the class declaring the member; rejects accessible objects that do not represent a member.

methods.name: getField
methods.documentation: Returns the first discovered field with the given name, including inherited fields.

methods.name: getFieldAnnotation
methods.documentation:
Returns the field's direct or composed annotation, if present; composed matches retain the outer annotation
 instance.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.documentation:
Reads a named field with reflective access enabled, returning an empty optional for a null target, missing
 field, or null value.

methods.name: getFirstTypeArgument
methods.documentation: Returns the first actual generic argument. A raw type is rejected with {@link IllegalArgumentException}.

methods.name: getGenericPropertyType
methods.documentation: Returns a field's generic type or a method's generic return type; rejects other accessible objects.

methods.name: getGenericType
methods.documentation: Resolves the requested supertype's generic arguments in the context of the candidate class.

methods.name: getMemberAnnotation
methods.documentation:
Finds an annotation on a method with the supplied name, falling back to a case-insensitive field-name match
 with an optional getter prefix removed.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.documentation: Returns the first discovered method with the given name; parameter types are not used to select an overload.

methods.name: getMethodAnnotation
methods.documentation: Returns the first matching direct or composed annotation in the executable's override hierarchy.

methods.name: getMethodAnnotations
methods.documentation: Returns matching annotations from the first declaration in the override hierarchy that supplies them.

methods.name: getMethodOverrideHierarchy
methods.documentation: Returns the method followed by the superclass and interface methods it overrides, without duplicates.

methods.name: getName
methods.documentation: Returns the member name; rejects accessible objects that do not represent a member.

methods.name: getPackageAndParentPackages
methods.documentation: Returns the package and the parent packages that can be resolved for its name.

methods.name: getPackageAnnotation
methods.documentation: Returns the requested annotation from the package or its enclosing package hierarchy, if present.

methods.name: getPackageAnnotations
methods.documentation: Returns package annotations, including those discovered recursively on enclosing packages.

methods.name: getPackageAnnotations
methods.documentation: Returns package annotations, optionally including enclosing packages when {@code recursive} is true.

methods.name: getParameterIndex
methods.documentation: Returns the zero-based position of the parameter in its declaring executable.

methods.name: getParameterOverrideHierarchy
methods.documentation:
Returns the parameter at the same position throughout its method's override hierarchy, or just the supplied
 constructor parameter.

methods.name: getPropertyAnnotation
methods.documentation:
Reads the value at a property path, returning an empty optional for a null target, missing property, or null
 value, including missing JSON fields and explicit JSON nulls. Despite its name, this method reads a value
 rather than annotation metadata.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.documentation:
Returns a field name or derives a property name from a method, stripping conventional {@code get} and {@code
 is} prefixes.

methods.name: getPropertyPathMetadata
methods.documentation:
Returns structural metadata for a nested property path; a null type or null or empty path yields missing
 metadata.

methods.name: getPropertyType
methods.documentation: Returns a field's declared type or a method's return type; rejects other accessible objects.

methods.name: getRegisteredTypes
methods.documentation:
Returns the loadable types from the generated application type registry.

The result is resolved once and uses the same class cache as {@link #classForName(String)}.

methods.name: getSimpleName
methods.documentation: Returns the class name after its last package or nested-class separator.

methods.name: getSimpleName
methods.documentation: Returns the final component of the package name.

methods.name: getSimpleName
methods.documentation: Returns the name after the last dot or dollar separator; null or blank names are rejected.

methods.name: getTypeAnnotation
methods.documentation:
Finds a direct or composed type annotation, falling back to enclosing classes; returns null if absent. For a
 composed annotation, the returned instance is the outer annotation.

methods.name: getTypeAnnotations
methods.documentation: Returns the cached annotations on the type and its interfaces, deduplicated by annotation type.

methods.name: getTypeArgument
methods.documentation:
Returns the actual generic argument at the zero-based index. A raw type is rejected with {@link
 IllegalArgumentException}.

methods.name: getTypeArguments
methods.documentation: Returns actual generic arguments for a parameterized type, or an empty list for a raw type.

methods.name: getTypeMetadata
methods.documentation: Returns the shared, class-scoped structural metadata for the given type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.documentation: Reads a field or invokes a property method with reflective access enabled.

methods.name: getValue
methods.documentation:
Reads a field or invokes a property method on the target. {@code forceAccess} controls whether Java access
 checks are suppressed where permitted.

methods.name: has
methods.documentation: Returns whether the method or an overridden declaration has the requested direct or composed annotation.

methods.name: has
methods.documentation: Returns whether the parameter directly carries the annotation or a composed annotation of that type.

methods.name: hasNonDefaultAnnotationAttribute
hasProperty
methods.documentation:
Returns whether the property path can be read, including a property whose value is null. Null targets and
 paths return false; failures other than a missing property propagate.

methods.name: hasReturnType
methods.documentation:
Returns whether the executable produces a result: constructors and methods whose return type is not {@code
 void} do.

methods.name: ifClass
isAnnotationPresent
methods.documentation: Returns whether the type, its interfaces, or an enclosing class supplies a matching annotation.

methods.name: isAnnotationPresent
methods.documentation: Returns whether the parameter has a direct or composed annotation of the requested type.

methods.name: isClass
methods.documentation: Returns whether the value represents a Java class or a supported Kotlin class literal.

methods.name: isKotlinDataClassComponent
methods.documentation:
Whether a no-argument method is a compiler-generated Kotlin data-class component accessor.
 These duplicate constructor properties and should not be inferred as additional domain properties.
 Handwritten component methods and ordinary Java methods are not excluded.

methods.name: isKotlinReflectionSupported
methods.documentation: Returns whether the optional Kotlin reflection implementation is available on the classpath.

methods.name: isLeafValue
methods.documentation:
Returns whether the given value should be treated as a terminal scalar during reflective traversal.

Leaf values are not recursively inspected for nested annotated properties. This is used by infrastructure such as search indexing and data protection to decide whether a value should be processed as a whole or traversed further.

A value is considered a leaf when it is:

  • {@code null}
  • one of the built-in scalar types known to Fluxzero, such as strings, numbers, booleans, temporal values, URIs, locales, and similar primitives/value objects
  • an enum
  • an instance of a type implementing {@link Leaf}
@param value the value to inspect @return {@code true} if the value should be treated as a leaf, {@code false} otherwise

methods.name: isMethodAnnotationPresent
methods.documentation: Returns whether an executable has a matching direct, meta-, or inherited method annotation.

methods.name: isNullable
methods.documentation:
Returns whether a parameter or an overridden declaration allows null according to nullable annotations or
 available Kotlin metadata.

methods.name: isOrHas
methods.documentation:
Returns whether the class is the requested annotation type or directly carries that annotation; null returns
 false.

methods.name: isOrHas
methods.documentation: Returns whether an annotation is of the requested type or directly carries that type as a meta-annotation.

methods.name: isStatic
methods.documentation: Returns whether the executable has the Java {@code static} modifier.

methods.name: loadClassWithoutInitialization
rawClass
readProperty
methods.documentation:
Reads a nested property path. Null targets, blank paths, missing properties, and null values yield an empty
 optional, including missing JSON fields and explicit JSON nulls; other access failures propagate.

methods.name: resolveRegisteredTypeName
setField
methods.documentation: Assigns a field declared directly on the target's class, with reflective access enabled.

methods.name: setField
methods.documentation: Assigns the field with reflective access enabled; access and assignment failures propagate.

methods.name: unbox
writeProperty
methods.documentation:
Writes a nested property if the target and property exist. A null target or missing property is ignored;
 other write failures propagate.
